tools.name: get_verification_result
tools.description:
Check progress of one verification by the order_id you got when ordering. Once the report is ready, returns what each of the three people saw, separately — not a merged verdict. We do not tell you what to conclude.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_verification_result" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check progress of one verification by the order_id you got when ordering. Once the report is ready, returns what each of the three people saw, separately — not …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_verification_result" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
